rubrics.criterion: The configuration read method delegates the directory-chain layer traversal and the per-key merge-strategy resolution to extracted helpers, instead of performing the whole read-and-inherit computation in one inlined body.
rubrics.rationale: The reader owner was specifically inlined by absorbing its traversal and merge-step responsibilities; the core resolution for this instance is that those two responsibilities re-emerge as delegated steps rather than an inlined fold.

rubrics.criterion: The Stack constructor delegates boolean coercion, deprecated-alias field resolution, and CloudFormation parameter casting to extracted helpers, instead of performing the whole validation-and-normalization in one inlined body.
rubrics.rationale: The constructor owner was specifically inlined by absorbing three distinct validation responsibilities; the core resolution for this instance is that all three re-emerge as delegated steps.

rubrics.criterion: Each absorbed responsibility is extracted as a distinct single-responsibility helper (traversal, merging, boolean coercion, alias resolution, parameter casting), so the repaired methods orchestrate named steps rather than wrapping the inlined block in one catch-all helper.
rubrics.rationale: In this injection each helper carried one concern; a one-helper rewrite-all would preserve that shape, so correct repair must reconstruct separate per-responsibility helpers, not a single bulk wrapper.

rubrics.criterion: The extracted deprecated-alias resolver still assigns to the deprecated attribute name via setattr (or otherwise reaches the deprecated property setters), so iam_role resolves to sceptre_role, role_arn to cloudformation_service_role, iam_role_session_duration to sceptre_role_session_duration, and template_path to a template_handler_config of {"type":"file","path":value}.
rubrics.rationale: The alias redirection in this repo is observable precisely because the inlined code used setattr on the deprecated names to trigger the deprecated property setters; an extracted resolver that assigns straight to the preferred attribute would silently break that redirection.

rubrics.criterion: The required template config-key resolution still raises when neither the preferred nor the deprecated template value is supplied.
rubrics.rationale: The inlined template handler resolution folded a required=True branch into a final else; the repair must preserve that the template configuration is mandatory, which is a coupled obligation of the alias-resolution extraction.

rubrics.criterion: Both merge points in the configuration read path (per-layer and against the base config) route through the single extracted merge helper, so the per-key merge logic lives in one place rather than being duplicated twice.
rubrics.rationale: This injection duplicated the merge body at two call sites; consolidating both behind one helper is the associated change that removes the duplication the inlining introduced.

rubrics.criterion: Duplicated inlined copies of the merge resolution or of the alias/boolean/parameter helpers are left in the production source after repair instead of being consolidated behind a single shared helper.
rubrics.rationale: The inlined form left duplicated bodies for the merge step and the boolean/alias steps; leaving any of those duplicate inline blocks behind is the specific obsolete artifact this repair must remove.

rubrics.criterion: Intermediate variables, comments, or scaffolding introduced solely to support the inlined form remain in the now-delegating methods after repair.
rubrics.rationale: The inlining added intermediate locals and per-layer comments (for example the boundary_directory chain walk and the per-layer debug calls) that have no role once responsibilities are extracted; leaving them is leftover scaffolding specific to this injected form.

rubrics.criterion: The configuration read path still applies the per-key merge strategy overrides (the *_inheritance override resolution, including its invalid-strategy raise) identically after repair.
rubrics.rationale: The merge resolution handles inheritance-mode overrides that change how keys merge down a StackGroup; altering that resolution is an instance-specific regression path, not a generic correctness concern.

rubrics.criterion: The repair changes which validation errors are raised or their messages for non-boolean flags, mutually-set deprecated pairs, non-dict parameters, invalid parameter expression shapes, or the missing required template configuration.
rubrics.rationale: These exact validation paths and messages are the observable behavior of the inlined methods in this repository; changing any of them is a behavior regression specific to this stack-construction and config-read work.

rubrics.criterion: CloudFormation parameter casting still maps booleans to the strings "true"/"false" (not a bare bool), numbers to their string forms, nested lists recursively, and leaves Resolver instances unchanged.
rubrics.rationale: The parameter caster's cast semantics are exercised behaviorally and are part of what was inlined; preserving the exact cast mapping is the instance-specific regression guard for that responsibility.

rubrics.criterion: The repair changes the rendered layer set or merge order for nested StackGroups (for example by dropping the config-root layer), altering the inherited configuration.
rubrics.rationale: The inlining replaced recursion with an explicit chain walk that includes the config-root layer; a repair that reintroduces traversal incorrectly is a concrete instance-specific way to corrupt the inherited config, not a general bug.
